title: rtx 5090 mod
description: This mod adds a decorative model of the RTX 5090 graphics card. It is crafted from a diamond, 4 pieces of iron, 2 green dyes, redstone, and a stone button.
body: This mod adds a decorative model of the RTX 5090 graphics card. It is crafted from a diamond, 4 pieces of iron, 2 green dyes, redstone, and a stone button.By the way, the mod doesn't work with redstone.
